audio_seconds_basis: exact wav header value (frames / sample rate), measured from the file here
authority: docs/readiness/2026-09-16-slurp-next-stage-owner-decisions-v1.md rows 67, 68, 71, 76a and 139 (the paired 400-row subset of the sealed union-4000, drawn once at seed 20260921; A2T-NULL first; the sealed direct rows as the comparator; the own null on the GPU queue); docs/readiness/2026-09-26-slurp-stage3-measurement-instrument-v1.md rules 3 and 6

contacts.audio: wav bytes hashed and wav headers read for duration; no decoding

coverage.why_no_new_supplement: contracts.gate_media_identity accepts exactly one supplement path per run and verifies only the samples the binding names, so the paired cells configure the union's own supplement; a subset copy would duplicate already-bound identities for no gate the union supplement does not already close
coverage.why_no_probe_view: every drawn id already resolves inside data.audio2tool's frozen-receipt universe; data.audio2tool._resolve_items refuses a sample id two probe-sample receipts claim, so an additive view for this roster would break the loader outright rather than add anything

design: The PAIRED 400 (owner decisions 67 and 71), roster_role 'evaluation': a 400-row tier-stratified subset (50 per tier over all eight tiers) of the sealed A2T-ORG1-UNION-4000, drawn ONCE by core.roster.freeze_roster at seed 20260921. Every Audio2Tool engineering cell of the current programme -- A2T-NULL (the carrier's own request-identical null, decision 68, flown first), A2T-NOTOOL, A2T-IDX, A2T-IDXT and the decision-76a direct-versus-system comparison -- reads on this roster, in both the natural-mixture and the equal-tier weighting, against the sealed union-4000 outputs of the same sample ids. The full 4,000 flies only for an admitted form.
flight_split_identity_hash_convention: data.splits.split_identity_hash(prefixed('audio2tool', sample_ids)) over audio2tool/<tier>:<id6> -- the value core.flight.FlightRuntime.preflight computes at flight time, and the value the frozen construction roster receipt beside this one already carries as its own split_identity_hash

packet_coverage.why: the sealed promotion SAEA-A2T-NATIVE-SYSTEM-PACKETS-V1 (2026-09-12, model-free, twenty CPU workers over the already-warm legacy cache) promoted every one of the union-4000 rows into the formal SpeechFeaturePacketV1 tree the committed direct baseline pins; a strict subset of the union needs nothing promoted

pairing: every one of these 400 rows carries a SEALED direct row from SAEA-A2T-NATIVE-ROLE-DIRECT-UNION4000-V1 (attempt-a2t-native-role-direct-union4000-generation-v1) -- the decision-76a comparator, same request protocol, same packets, same geometry -- and a sealed official-protocol raw-audio output from the 2026-09-04 official-population flights; every paired cell is read against those bytes and nothing is re-flown on the comparator side
role: the roster of every Audio2Tool engineering cell of the current programme, A2T-NULL first; it decides nothing by itself
selection_rule: core.roster.freeze_roster over the union receipt's own 4,000 items, stratum = tier, per_stratum = 50, seed 20260921, one shared rng advanced across strata in ascending name order; no exclusion and no group key, because the parent population is already the sealed draw. The seed is owner decision 71's, stated there before this draw.
split_identity_hash_convention: sha256 over the LF-joined sorted 'key' values (audio2tool:<tier>:<id6>, UTF-8, no trailing newline) -- the Audio2Tool probe-receipt integrity convention
strata: tier (50 per tier, all eight) and domain
strata_basis: tier is carried per item. Domain is NOT: it is the domain column of each tier's released manifest, recorded here as aggregate counts exactly as the union receipt records it, and resolved per sample at ANALYSIS time from the same manifests. Keeping it out of the item rows keeps this receipt's item shape identical to the union's and keeps a gold-adjacent label out of the file the flight entry point reads to build its samples
